sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Establishment**: Set up in 1981, succeeding the 'Pre-investment Survey of Forest Resources' (PISFR).
• **Mandate**: To conduct biennial assessments of forest cover and growing stock, and provide technical support to states.
• **Primary Tool**: Uses Remote Sensing (RS) technology, specifically data from Resourcesat-2 (LISS-III sensor).
• **Key Metric**: The 'India State of Forest Report' (ISFR) is the flagship publication released every two years.

items.term: Forest Cover vs. Recorded Forest Area
items.definition: Forest Cover refers to all lands >1 hectare with tree canopy density >10% (satellite-based). Recorded Forest Area refers to legal status (Reserved/Protected/Unclassed) under the Indian Forest Act, 1927.
Tree patches <1 hectare, including scattered trees, orchards, and plantations, not captured in satellite forest cover mapping.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **NFI (National Forest Inventory)**: Ground-based sampling to estimate growing stock and carbon sequestration.
• **Fire Alert System**: Real-time monitoring using MODIS and SNPP-VIIRS satellite data.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Challenges**: Difficulty in distinguishing between natural forests and plantations; resolution limits of LISS-III.
• **Solutions**: Integration of LiDAR technology and high-resolution satellite data (Cartosat) for precision.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'V-M-O-S' (Very, Moderately, Open, Scrub).
• **Decoded Meaning**: V(70+), M(40-70), O(10-40), S(<10). Remember: 'Scrub is NOT Forest'.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses 'Forest Cover' with 'Recorded Forest Area'. Remember: Forest Cover is a physical measurement (satellite), while Recorded Forest Area is a legal classification (administrative).
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Carbon Sink Potential' when discussing FSI data in the context of India's NDC (Nationally Determined Contributions) under the Paris Agreement.

keyTakeaways: FSI is an attached office under MoEFCC, not a statutory body.
Forest Cover includes all land with >10% canopy density, regardless of legal status.
ISFR is the most authentic data source for India's forest health and carbon stock.
